Australotitan belongs to Jurassic Park. is an extinct genus of titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur that lived in Queensland, Australia during the Late Cretaceous period.

Did you know?

  • Evidence around Australotitan is classified as fiction on Ton-o-Lore.

page.overview:
Who is Australotitan?

Australotitan belongs to Jurassic Park. is an extinct genus of titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur that lived in Queensland, Australia during the Late Cretaceous period.

It is the biggest dinosaur discovered in Australia. Australotitan appears in the game as an omega fierce non-hybrid dinosaur. It was released in Update 3.1, specifically in the South Korea release.
